title: A generator criterion for annihilating an exterior tensor quotient kernel
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and S=(K→B→C) a short exact sequence of module sheaves with maps f,g. Let A,D be any module sheaves, r,s natural numbers, T=(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s B), Q=(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s C), using [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Let q:T→Q take each tensor of pure wedges a,c to a⊗g(c). If ψ:T→D sends every tensor of pure wedges a,c with c_j=f(d), for any j and any section d of K on the same open, to zero, then the kernel inclusion of q followed by ψ is zero.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: exterior-power universal properties and independence of quotient lifts

proof.text: If s=0, use exteriorSheaf_zero_iso for B and C. Their composite identifies empty wedges; exteriorSheafTensor_lift_hom_ext with the identity of B identifies q with the tensor of this isomorphism and the identity. Thus q is mono, its kernel inclusion is zero, and the conclusion follows without using hzero. The retirement compatibility theorem exteriorSheafTensor_lift_hom_ext transports this invocation through the canonical exteriorSheafPowerIso to the official exteriorPower/wedge theorem, preserving the statement.

For s≠0, tensor exteriorSheafPowerIso in both factors. Its inverse preserves wedge tensors by tensorHom_app_tmulSection and exteriorSheafPowerIso_inv_wedge; inverse cancellation gives the forward formula. Conjugate q by these comparisons, obtaining the upstream pure-wedge formula from hq. A section k of kernel(q) maps to t with q(t)=0 by kernel.condition. The conjugated map kills the forward image of t. Apply the upstream local span theorem at every point of U. The inverse comparison sends each upstream relation generator to an original relation generator, killed by hzero. Submodule.span_le puts the whole upstream span in the kernel of ψ after the inverse comparison. Naturality and inverse cancellation identify this vanishing with ψ(t restricted to V)=0. Sheaf section_ext and naturality prove ψ(t)=0. Extensionality over U and k gives kernel.ι q ≫ ψ = 0. The comparison helper and all the transport are proved in the consumer; its public signature is unchanged.

theorem exteriorTensor_kernel_eq_zero_of_relations {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (A D : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ)
    (q : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ s ⟶
      exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ s)
    (ψ : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ s ⟶ D)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      q.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ s U c)) =
        tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf A r) (N := exteriorSheaf S.X₃ s)
          (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ s U (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i))))
    (hzero : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)) (j : Fin s) (d : S.X₁.val.obj (op U)),
      c j = S.f.val.app (op U) d →
      ψ.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ s U c)) = 0) :
    kernel.ι q ≫ ψ = 0
